crossRefs.note: “Go up on her walls, and destroy; but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.
For Yahweh of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She…
For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah…
In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came…
Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts, to…
At the end of years they will join themselves together; and the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king…
I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram, and broke his two horns.…
No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will…
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.

translations.web: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his chosen people, neither will there be any strength to stand.
translations.bsb: Then the king of the North will come, build up a siege ramp, and capture a fortified city. The forces of the South will not stand; even their best troops will not be able to resist.
translations.kjv: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.
translations.asv: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city: and the forces of the south shall not stand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to stand.
